gizmo.title: Nīnau helu
gizmo.description: He nīnau i pane ʻia me ka helu. He helu paʻa ka pane a i ʻole he kumulā i helu ʻia mai nā hualoli, a helu ʻia ke aia i loko o ka palena ʻae.

configure.title: Nīnau
configure.description: Ka mea i nīnau ʻia i nā haumāna. E kākau i ka inoa o kekahi hualoli i loko o nā kahaapo ʻōniʻoniʻo, e like me {d}, e hōʻike ai i kona waiwai.

configure.title: Anakahi
configure.description: Hōʻike ʻia ma ke ʻano he kikokikona ma ka ʻaoʻao o ke kahua pane, no ka laʻana km/h.

configure.title: Pane
configure.description: Ka helu pololei. E waiho hakahaka ke helu ke kumulā i ka pane.

configure.title: Kumulā
configure.description: Helu i ka pane mai nā hualoli, no ka laʻana d / (t / 60). Hiki ke hoʻohana i + - * / ^, nā kahaapo, sqrt() a me abs(). Hoʻohana ʻia ma kahi o ka pane ke hoʻonohonoho ʻia.

configure.title: Nā hualoli
configure.description: Nā helu a ke kumulā a me ka nīnau e hoʻohana ai. Lawe kēlā me kēia i kekahi waiwai ma waena o kona haʻahaʻa loa a me kona kiʻekiʻe loa, ma nā ʻanuʻu.

advanced.title: Palena ʻae
advanced.description: Ka mamao mai ka pane pololei e helu ʻia nō. ʻO ka 0, pololei, a i ʻole hoʻopuni ʻia i nā wahi kekimala ma lalo.

advanced.title: ʻAno palena ʻae
advanced.description: Paʻa: hui a lawe paha i ka palena ʻae. Pakeneka: hui a lawe paha i kēlā pakeneka o ka pane pololei.

advanced.title: Nā wahi kekimala
advanced.description: Noi ʻia nā haumāna e hoʻopuni i kēia nui o nā wahi, a hōʻike ʻia ka pane i hoʻopuni ʻia pēlā. E waiho hakahaka no ka hoʻopuni ʻole.

advanced.title: Nā hoʻāʻo
advanced.description: ʻEhia manawa e hiki ai i kekahi haumāna ke nānā. ʻO ka 0, palena ʻole.

advanced.title: Nā helu hou i kēlā me kēia hoʻāʻo
advanced.description: E lawe i nā waiwai hualoli hou i kēlā me kēia manawa e hoʻāʻo hou ai ka haumāna. ʻAʻole hōʻike ʻia kā lākou pane mua ke hoʻi mai lākou, inā pololei wale nō.

advanced.title: Hiki ke ʻōpiʻi
advanced.description: Hōʻike i kēia nīnau ma ke ʻano he lālani e wehe a pani ai. Ke wehe ʻia kekahi, pani ʻia nā nīnau ʻōpiʻi ʻē aʻe ma kona ʻaoʻao.

advanced.title: Hoʻomaka me ka ʻōpiʻi
advanced.description: Ke hiki ke ʻōpiʻi, e hoʻomaka ma ke ʻano he lālani pani e hōʻike ana i ka nīnau a me kona kūlana wale nō.

developer.title: Inoa o ka hoʻokolohua
developer.description: Inoa hoʻokolohua i hoʻohana ʻia no ka hōʻike xAPI ma nā ʻōnaehana kālailai.
